asides.text: and you may notice he's clean shaven and sporting a crew cut. Apparently, he got a little too far off the grid in the upper peninsula and went missing for several days. The Mounties found him dressed in a fresh deer skin trying to build a makeshift cabin. He was a bit dazed from lack of food and sleep, but he's okay. Mostly his pride was hurt. Nothing a little bed rest and a regiment of milkshakes and vitamins can't take care of. It happens to the best of us.
asides.note: Parker lost in the Upper Peninsula

asides.text: And now a fan is on the field. Actually, that's what we used to call a streaker. Great day in the morning. Producer Phil, I haven't seen one of those since 1978. And the grounds crew is giving chase.
